title: Small robot. Unsubtle intentions.
author: dachi
summary: A look at the 2026 sumo build: a low wedge, three forward-looking ultrasonic modules, and electronics packed into a compact chassis.
mediaAlt: The sumo robot on a green cutting mat.
content:
## Looking for an opponent, remembering the edge

The current 2026 source adds two edge inputs and remote motor enable to the ultrasonic opponent-seeking approach. Its Wi-Fi debug page exposes sensor state and motor tests.

The earlier 2024 firmware remains linked as an archive. Its sensing and control behavior should not be confused with the current version.
